summary: Full e2e testing of Fixd Admin Panel features. All 13 backend API tests passed. Frontend admin login, dashboard tabs (Bookings, Settings, Calendar), logout, and contact form all working correctly.

issues: Uses browser native input[type='date'] (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of shadcn Calendar component. Inconsistent with app design language.

action_items: Minor: Consider replacing native date input with shadcn Calendar component for design consistency
critical_code_review_comments: Admin password stored in plaintext in MongoDB (no bcrypt hashing). Security risk if DB is compromised.
Default admin password visible in plaintext on the login page (Default password: Fixd@Admin2024) - security concern for production.
JWT_SECRET fallback is hardcoded as 'fixd_secret' - must be set via env var in production.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Admin Panel Test contact submission during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin panel fully tested and working. Login at /admin (password: Fixd@Admin2024), dashboard at /admin/dashboard with 3 tabs: Bookings (shows contacts list), Settings (phone/whatsapp/email/hours/address + change password), Calendar (Google OAuth setup).
